Chat streaming against real OpenAI API, verifies chunks received

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
api_key = ENV.fetch("OPENAI_API_KEY")
client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = client.chat_stream(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(max_tokens: 50, messages: [{ 'content' => 'Count from 1 to 5.', 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'openai/gpt-4o-mini')).to_a
puts result.inspect
```
